examples.title: What is Complex Differential Geometry?
examples.content: Complex differential geometry combines complex analysis with differential geometry, studying complex manifolds, holomorphic functions, and their geometric properties.

examples.title: About This Book
examples.content: This text by Jean-Pierre Demailly covers fundamental concepts from differential calculus on manifolds to advanced topics like sheaf theory, Hodge theory, and L² estimates.

simulator.title: The Riemann Sphere
simulator.description: The Riemann sphere ℂ∪{∞} is a fundamental example of a compact complex manifold. It represents the extended complex plane.

applications.title: Algebraic Geometry
applications.description: Complex geometry provides the analytic foundation for studying algebraic varieties and their properties.

applications.title: String Theory
applications.description: Calabi-Yau manifolds from complex geometry play a central role in string theory compactifications.

concepts.name: Complex Manifold
concepts.definition: A manifold with an atlas of charts to ℂⁿ where transition maps are holomorphic.

concepts.name: Holomorphic Function
concepts.definition: A complex-differentiable function, equivalently one satisfying the Cauchy-Riemann equations.

exercises.question: Why is the Riemann sphere a natural compactification of the complex plane?
exercises.hint: Consider stereographic projection from S² to ℂ.

exercises.question: What makes complex manifolds more rigid than real manifolds?
exercises.hint: Think about holomorphic vs smooth transition functions.

diagrams.title: Stereographic Projection
diagrams.description: Visualize how the sphere projects onto the complex plane.
diagrams.instructions: The sphere minus the north pole maps bijectively to ℂ.

diagrams.title: Holomorphic Vector Field
diagrams.description: A vector field induced by z ↦ z² on the complex plane.
diagrams.instructions: Observe the fixed point at the origin and the flow pattern.
